overview_description.description: Wilzy offers a unified financial application that combines learning, planning, and investing in one platform. The company provides guided tools that help users understand their financial position, set goals, and build tailored plans. Through the Wilzy app, individuals can access investment products such as stock market access, equity funds, fixed income funds, and Sharia-compliant funds. The platform includes AI-based features for answering financial questions, tracking net worth, and supporting decision-making. Wilzy operates as a regulated brokerage under the Financial Regulatory Authority and is part of Act Financial Group, focusing on digital wealth and trading services delivered via mobile and web channels.
